evals.prompt: Create a new tier-2 skill for API documentation
expectations: The agent checks references/standards/README.md for frontmatter contract
The agent uses create-skill.js with --tier 2 flag
The output has tier-2 structure with SKILL.md + references/ directory
The description follows CSO guidelines (starts with 'Use when')

evals.prompt: How do I structure a tier-3 platform skill?
expectations: The agent references the tier-3-platform template
The agent explains the 5-file structure per product (README, api, configuration, patterns, gotchas)
The agent mentions progressive disclosure for tier-3

evals.prompt: What is the capital of France?
expectations: The agent does NOT load writing-skills
The agent responds with general knowledge

evals.prompt: Fix the frontmatter on all my skill files
expectations: The agent validates CSV format for tags/triggers/references
